en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town street dominated by a Baroque church with an onion‑shaped dome and tower. The church is on the left side, with stucco walls, arched windows and a small side building; a balustraded stairway with statues descends toward the street. On the right, a row of 2–3‑storey houses with shops at ground level lines a cobblestone road. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or sit near the church, and a horse‑drawn cart or early vehicle is visible further down the street. The image has wide white margins like a photographic postcard. No clear text is visible.
